text: Priya (PM): Usability run flagged another docs-panel mismatch: the in-app help panel uses the word 'Pin' while the docs glossary uses 'Pin / Version'. Testers searched for 'pin shortcut' and got no hits. Anil (Design): We tried to keep panel copy ultra-short. Maybe we should show 'Pin (Version)' in the panel title and add a tiny keyboard shortcut hint 'Press P' that opens the panel. But confirm with a11y first. Rae (Docs): Docs canonical entry is 'Pin (model version)'. I'll add synonyms in the search index for 'pin', 'shortcut', 'pinning', and add a dedicated glossary anchor #pinning-shortcut. Also can add a one-line note at top of the panel: "Keyboard: press P to open pin help" that links to the glossary anchor. Sunny (Eng): Two implementation points: (1) fragments won't hit server so add alias anchors for old links; (2) keyboard shortcut binding needs to be opt-in for users who have screen reader modes. We should gate the shortcut behind a user preference and expose it in accessibility settings. Anil (Design): Good call. For the visible panel label I prefer 'Pin (Version)'—clear and compact. The inline link text should be explicit for screen readers: 'Open pinning docs and shortcut'. We'll also include a role=button with aria-pressed for the shortcut toggle. A11yBot: checklist: tooltip focusable, shortcut opt-out present, aria-describedby for the panel heading, link text descriptive. Rae (Docs): I'll add #pinning-shortcut anchor and a short paragraph showing the shortcut flow and pin examples. Also will add a redirect alias for legacy fragments. Adding search synonyms now. PR ETA tonight. Sunny (Eng): Implementation plan: (1) add the user preference flag in settings (default enabled), (2) register global key handler 'P' when enabled and not when in form inputs, (3) wire the help link to '#pinning-shortcut' and include hidden alias ids for backwards compatibility, (4) tests: e2e to assert keyboard opens panel and focus lands on H2. Priya (PM): QA requests: (A) e2e for shortcut open/focus, (B) regression test for old deep-links like /docs/models#pin resolving to the same H2, (C) support note saying: "If you searched for 'pin shortcut', see glossary entry 'Pin (model version)'." Anil (Design): I'll update the Figma frames with the 'Pin (Version)' label and the shortcut hint variants (hint-only vs hint+icon). Marking hint+icon as preferred. Rae (Docs): Will add the glossary cross-link at top of the in-panel docs and include the alias anchors and search synonyms. PR later today. Sunny (Eng): I'll open a tiny feature branch feature/pin-shortcut-docs to implement label, aria changes, preference flag, and tests. Will include analytics mapping so we don't change event names. A11yBot: add manual test: keyboard-only user toggles shortcut preference -> verify shortcut no longer opens panel. Also screen reader check for descriptive link text. Priya (PM): Great. Target next minor. Ping when docs PR and UI branch are up and when QA ticket created. Thanks all!
